label: Gentle Muse · Spooky Season
source: Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, Mary Shelley · HAL-004

beats.html:
She started Frankenstein
in the summer of 1816.

The year without a
summer. A volcano put
enough ash in the sky
that Europe stayed
under cloud.

She was stuck indoors
with nothing
going right.

She invented a genre
anyway. The conditions
were never the
requirement.

Send this to whoever
is waiting for a
better year.

clip.match_reason: The turn is a person who kept working while the conditions were against her. The plate is Amanda holding the lens with her mouth closed, the only frame in the library that puts her own face behind a claim about work.
